thread:
elaine: FYI I opened a docs PR for Dedicated provisioning tweaks -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420 :eyes:
elaine: TL;DR: clarifies SLA language for reserved pools, adds an autoscale cooldown section, and a short note about tenant isolation during eviction. I also added a TODO for a short SDK snippet showing the scale policy usage in terraform + python SDK.
ben: skimmed the PR. small nit: SLA phrasing on burst capacity still reads as if bursts bypass isolation rules. can we make it explicit they still respect tenant isolation?
amara: can take the SDK snippet. do we want both terraform and python or a single canonical example?
elaine: both please. terraform for infra teams, python for app/platform examples. keep them tiny. aim to land the PR today if tests pass.
amara: putting a quick draft here — feedback welcome:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_scale_policy" "example" {
  tenant_id        = "tenant-123"
  min_gpus         = 1
  max_gpus         = 8
  cooldown_seconds = 300 # prevents thrashing after bursts
  preemption_policy = "notify-and-drain"
}
```
amara: and a 2-line python SDK snippet for docs:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.set_scale_policy(tenant_id="tenant-123", min_gpus=1, max_gpus=8, cooldown_seconds=300)
```
lisa: nice, can we also show the recommended `preemption_policy` options in a footnote? we should call out impact on SLA (e.g., drain vs immediate).
ben: also add a short migration blurb for legacy `scaleCooldown` field — we changed the key name in v2 of the schema, some customers will have automation that writes `scaleCooldown`.
suresh: I can draft the migration snippet; will paste in a follow-up comment. also: the link to the handbook in the PR currently points to /handbook/provisioning which 404s — I can push a quick link fix in the PR branch if you want.
elaine: please do the link fix, @suresh. add the migration note as a new section under "Config migration".
suresh: done, pushed a small commit with corrected link and a one-paragraph migration note.
docs-bot: doc build passed for branch docs/pr-1420 (lint: ok, links: 1 warn)
elainе: thanks everyone — assigning reviewers @ben and @lisa, tagging @oncall for visibility. will merge after a quick review. :shipit:
ben: quick review done, left one inline about wording and a tiny formatting nit.
amara: addressed the nit and added the preemption options footnote. updated PR.
elaine: merging in 10 if no objections. cc: @support — note this wording change may require a brief customer comms for Dedicated customers who rely on preemption behaviors.
lisa: ack. small ask: can we add a line in the changelog that this doc change is documentation-only (no runtime change)? avoids confusion.
elaine: added changelog entry. merging now.
notes: This thread coordinates a docs PR for Dedicated provisioning: SLA wording, autoscale cooldown, preemption policy, SDK snippets (terraform + python), migration note and a link fix. Short, practical convo with an inline code block and bot confirmation.
